scope: Proposition 5.1 (Selection with bounded cylinder probabilities) of the manuscript “Balanced counterexamples to Ryser's conjecture at prime orders” (preprints/Balanced-Counterexamples-to-Rysers-Conjecture-at-Prime-Orders-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 162 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5be7cf2d1f382e80), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix constants c∗, C∗ > 0 and 0 < c0 ≤ 1, and put β = 1/8. For each sufficiently large integer q, let a finite graph have its vertex set partitioned into n = 2(q+1) slots Qi, with no edge within a slot. Write N(v) for the neighborhood of a vertex. Suppose that c∗q ≤ |Qi| ≤ q, |N(v)| ≤ C∗q, |N(v) ∩ Qi| ≤ qβ , (21) |J(v)| ≤ qβ , |N(v) ∩ N(w)| ≤ qβ (w / ∈ J(v)), (22) where every w ∈ J(v) is either adjacent to v or in its slot. There are constants K∗, ρ > 0, depending only on c∗, C∗, c0, and a random procedure which either fails or returns an independent transversal (Vi)i∈I0 , where I0 is the set of slots and Vi ∈ Qi. If A denotes its event of returning a transversal, then P(A) = 1 − o(1). (23) For any s distinct slots i1, . . . , is and any prescribed vertices vj ∈ Qij , P (︁ A, Vij = vj (1 ≤ j ≤ s) )︁ ≤ (K∗/q)s . (24) Suppose also that the slots are indexed by (g, k), with two slots for each direction g of an affine plane of order q. Associate to each vertex in slot (g, k) a line of direction g, injectively within that slot. For every affine line ℓ, let Tℓ ⊆ ℓ be a fixed set of at least c0q points. From Tℓ remove every point on a selected line different from ℓ, and call the remaining set Tfin ℓ . Then the same procedure satisfies P (︁ A, min ℓ |Tfin ℓ | < ρq )︁ = o(1). (25) The errors in (23) and (25) are uniform in all the stated input data. By the injectivity within a slot, (24) also holds for prescribed candidate lines.
